name: How often should I have my gas lines inspected?

mainEntity.name: How often should I have my gas lines inspected?

acceptedAnswer.text: Regular gas line inspections are important for ensuring the safety and efficiency of your home's gas system. While there isn't a universal mandatory frequency, it is generally recommended to have your gas lines professionally inspected every 3-5 years, especially if your home is older or if you've recently had appliance work done. Additionally, always schedule an inspection if you suspect a leak or notice any issues with gas appliances. Proactive inspections can help prevent dangerous situations.
acceptedAnswer.description: It's recommended to have gas lines inspected every 3-5 years, or immediately if a leak is suspected.
